slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
第三章一年之约
星陨长老知道，想按原计划将苏尘废去丹田、逐出山门，是不太可能了。
但，他还是有办法在苏尘的修炼之路上制造一点阻碍，好让苏尘无法超过他心爱的弟子陆远。
“苏尘虽然逃过废去丹田的命运，但做杂役的处罚也不轻啊，干一年杂活，还不能修炼。”
“昔日的天才变成杂役，这落差不是一般人能承受的。”
“该！谁让他藏私，修为进步得那么快，还会炼丹，也不提携我们这些同门一把，呸。”
许多弟子平时早就对天赋拔尖的苏尘嫉妒不已，现在有了落井下石的机会，他们自然不介意在后面推苏尘一把。
苏尘冷笑一声，他早料到，星陨长老不可能被他一个毫无背景的小弟子这么简单的扳倒。
如果一个呼风唤雨的实权长老能这么简单被扳倒的话，那正一宗也就不是方圆三千之里内最大的宗门了。
“好了，苏尘，收拾你的东西，下山去杂役院吧！”
星陨长老冷笑着开口，他作为正一宗的实权长老，只要有合适的借口，想打压苏尘这样的小弟子也不是什么难事。
苏尘想和他斗，终究还是太嫩！
然而，就当星陨长老内心得意洋洋的时候。
却听苏尘再度淡然的声音响起，所说出来的内容，再度让所有人大吃一惊。
“从今天起，我退出正一宗。”
什么！
所有人都不敢相信自己的耳朵。
苏尘要退出正一宗？
方圆千里内那么多人做梦都想挤进来的宗门，他竟然轻描淡写的说走就走？
星陨长老也愣住，怒道：“苏尘，你说什么？”

“你们费尽心机陷害我，不就是为了让我离开正一宗么？正好正一宗我也没有放在眼中。“
“区区正一宗，我退出。”
苏尘冷冷的最后看了大殿中这些人一眼，收起了自己炼制出的聚气丹，随后直接转身离去。
直到苏尘彻底走出了大殿，在场众人都还沉浸在浓郁的震惊之中。
他们今天不光见识了苏尘一直隐藏的炼丹技艺，而且还见证了苏尘退出正一宗！
在其他人眼中令人艳羡的正一宗弟子身份，对苏尘来说，仿佛是一堆随时可摒弃的垃圾。
就好似他说的那般，区区正一宗他没有放在眼中！
然而，就在众人还未彻底回神的时候，一名守山弟子又从山下急匆匆的跑上来，手里举着一副卷轴：“禀告长老，这是苏尘在离开山门之前最后留下的的一样东西，他让弟子给您送上来！”
星陨长老正在气头上，闻言顺手接过那个卷轴，展开一看。
结果，卷轴上的字，更让星陨长老差点气晕！
只见卷轴上，墨淋淋的写着十九个触目惊心的大字：
“一年之后，必归来，踏平正一宗，杀星陨长老、陆远！”
十九个大字，让现场所有人，再度惊骇莫名！
不得不说，苏尘的胆子，实在太大。
“岂有此理！”
星陨长老重重一拍面前的桌案，拍得木屑纷飞，就要叫人去把苏尘这个小孽畜抓回来。
但，苏尘这个时候，早已离开山门，不知所踪。
“师尊，这只不过是失败者可悲的叫嚣而已，何必在意呢？”
陆远温文尔雅的一笑，眼神中尽显轻蔑，劝说道。
星陨长老很快冷静下来，也知道苏尘卷轴中的内容是不可能实现的。

一个十五岁的小弟子，又没有了正一宗的秘籍和资源支持，别说一年了，就算十年，他也绝对不可能成长到能与正一宗分庭抗礼的程度。
他的叫嚣，只能是注定无法实现的疯话而已。
冷静下来的星陨长老，思索片刻，嗤笑一声：“好，那老夫就拭目以待，一年之后他到底能到何种地步！”
反正，虽然事实和计划之中有些出入，但他们还是达到了一部分目的——让苏尘离开正一宗！
content_en:
Chapter 3 One-year appointment
Elder Xingyun knew that it was impossible to banish Su Chen from his dantian and drive him out of the mountain gate as planned.
However, he still had a way to create some obstacles on Su Chen's path of cultivation so that Su Chen could not surpass his beloved disciple Lu Yuan.
"Although Su Chen escaped the fate of losing his Dantian, the punishment of being a handyman is not light. He has to work as a handyman for a year and is still unable to practice."
"The genius of the past has become a handyman. This gap is not something ordinary people can bear."
"That's right! Who allowed him to hide his secrets? His cultivation has improved so quickly, he can also make elixirs, and he doesn't support us fellow disciples. Bah."
Many disciples have always been jealous of Su Chen, who was extremely talented. Now that they have the opportunity to add insult to injury, they naturally don't mind pushing Su Chen from behind.
Su Chen sneered. He had expected that Elder Xingyun would not be defeated so easily by a young disciple with no background.
If a powerful elder who controls everything can be brought down so easily, then Zhengyi Sect will not be the largest sect within a radius of three thousand miles.
"Okay, Su Chen, pack your things and go down the mountain to the courtyard!"
Elder Xingyun said with a sneer. As the powerful elder of Zhengyi Sect, it would not be difficult for him to suppress a young disciple like Su Chen as long as he had a suitable excuse.
Su Chen wanted to fight him, but he was still too young after all!
However, just when Elder Xingyun was feeling proud in his heart.
But they heard Su Chen's calm voice again, and what he said once again surprised everyone.
"From today on, I quit the Zhengyi Sect."
What!
Everyone couldn't believe their ears.
Su Chen wants to quit Zhengyi Sect?
There were so many people within a thousand miles of the sect who would only dream of squeezing in, and yet he just left in an understatement?
Elder Xingyun was also stunned and said angrily: "Su Chen, what did you say?"
"You have tried so hard to frame me, isn't it just to get me to leave the Zhengyi Sect? It just so happens that I don't pay attention to the Zhengyi Sect."
"It's just a sect, I quit."
Su Chen gave the people in the hall a final cold look, put away the Qi Gathering Pill he had refined, and then turned around and left.
Until Su Chen completely walked out of the hall, everyone present was still immersed in strong shock.
Today they not only witnessed Su Chen's hidden alchemy skills, but they also witnessed Su Chen's withdrawal from Zhengyi Sect!
In the eyes of others, his status as a disciple of the Zhengyi Sect was enviable, but to Su Chen, it seemed like a pile of garbage that could be discarded at any time.
Just like what he said, he didn't take it seriously!
However, before everyone could fully recover, a disciple guarding the mountain hurriedly ran up from the bottom of the mountain, holding a scroll in his hand: "Tell the elder, this is the last thing Su Chen left before leaving the mountain gate. He asked the disciple to bring it up to you!"
Elder Xingyun was furious. Hearing this, he took the scroll and unfolded it to take a look.
As a result, the words on the scroll made Elder Xingyun almost faint!
I saw nineteen shocking large characters written on the scroll:
"One year later, I will definitely return, defeat the Zhengyi Sect, and kill Elder Xingyun and Lu Yuan!"
Nineteen big characters made everyone at the scene horrified and inexplicable again!
I have to say that Su Chen's courage is really too great.
"That's unreasonable!"
Elder Xingyun slapped the table in front of him hard, causing sawdust to fly, and he wanted to call someone to catch Su Chen, this little evil beast.
However, at this time, Su Chen had already left the mountain gate and was missing.
"Master, this is just the pathetic cry of a loser, why should you care?"
Lu Yuan persuaded with a gentle smile and contempt in his eyes.
Elder Xingyun quickly calmed down and knew that the contents in Su Chen's scroll were impossible to realize.
A fifteen-year-old disciple, without the support of Zhengyi Sect's secret books and resources, let alone one year,Even in ten years, there is absolutely no way he would have grown enough to compete with the Zhengyi Sect.
His clamor can only be crazy talk that is destined to be impossible to achieve.
Elder Xingyun calmed down, thought for a moment, and sneered: "Okay, then I will wait and see how far he can be in a year's time!"
Anyway, although there were some discrepancies between the facts and the plan, they still achieved part of their goal - to get Su Chen to leave Zhengyi Sect!
